note: The user selected `serena` for the coworker after listening to the `serena`/`vivian` two-line audition and the adjacent `sohee` learner reference on 2026-08-01. Learner is `sohee` and narrator is `aiden`, matching the taproom so the learner and the storyteller are the same person across the app. The first complete batch pins its stable line-id-derived seeds so the integrated candidate is reproducible; the required full human listening pass over all 27 shipped clips remains open until the user hears them in the app. `speed` is deliberately absent — it is a no-op on the CustomVoice path. This is the first manifest to ship `instruct` direction; section-level direction sets each speaker's baseline and per-line direction overrides it only where needed. Clips ship to app/public/audio/office-gig/.
instruct: Natural, relaxed spoken Japanese. Two coworkers on a Friday, not a service counter.

sections.coworker: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
sections.learner: Even, clearly spaced, unhurried. The learner imitates this reading directly.
sections.narrator: Quiet, unhurried scene-setting. Reads the room, never addresses anyone.

lines.text: 金曜日の昼休み。休憩室で、同僚が音楽を聞いていた。
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.deliveryIntent: Opens the story from the cover. Unhurried, no warmth.

lines.text: あ、おつかれさまです。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: A greeting on noticing someone. Brief, not performed.

lines.text: おつかれさまです。
lines.speaker: learner
lines.deliveryIntent: Plain and even; a free ride that models the register.

lines.text: そのTシャツ、何のバンドですか。
lines.speaker: learner
lines.deliveryIntent: Curious, a little tentative at the head of the line.

lines.text: 高校のときからずっと好きなバンドなんですよ。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: Fond, slightly amused at herself. The warmest line in stage 1.

lines.text: 私もロック、好きなんです。
lines.speaker: learner
lines.deliveryIntent: Offering something about yourself; small lift on 好き.

lines.text: じつは私、ギターをやってるんですよ。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: A small confession she is pleased to make; じつは carries it.

lines.text: 自動販売機の前に、缶コーヒーが二つ並んだ。
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.deliveryIntent: Quiet, marking that the break has settled.

lines.text: ふだんはどんなの聞くんですか。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: Genuine curiosity, casual. ふだん should sound offhand.

lines.text: ギターの音が好きで、よくロックを聞きます。
lines.speaker: learner
lines.deliveryIntent: The longest learner line. Even pace, a clear break at the comma.

lines.text: ギターがいいと、それだけで聞いちゃいますよね。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: Opinionated and companionable; the よね reaches for agreement.

lines.text: じゃあ、おすすめはなんですか。
lines.speaker: learner
lines.deliveryIntent: Asking someone who clearly knows more. Light questioning rise.

lines.text: ちょうど土曜日にライブがあるんですよ。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: The hinge of the story. Offhand, as if it just occurred to her.

lines.text: 小さいライブハウスなんですけど、音がいいんですよ。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: Fondly qualifying — small place, good sound.

lines.text: 夕方、会社の玄関でまた会った。
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.deliveryIntent: Marks the jump to evening. Flatter than the other three cards.

lines.text: あ、さっきの話なんですけど。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: Catching someone on the way out. Slight rise on けど.

lines.text: じつは、チケットが一枚あまってるんです。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: Matter-of-fact, not pleading. She is offering, not asking a favour.

lines.text: 私も行ってもいいですか。
lines.speaker: learner
lines.deliveryIntent: Asking permission to join. Polite, a little hopeful.

lines.text: ぜひ、一緒に行きましょう。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: Warm and immediate. ぜひ is the whole line.

lines.text: チケットはいくらですか。
lines.speaker: learner
lines.deliveryIntent: Practical question, no hesitation.

lines.text: 三千円ですけど、当日でいいですよ。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: Practical, reassuring on the second half.

lines.text: 外は、もう暗くなっていた。
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.deliveryIntent: The quietest of the four cards.

lines.text: 土曜日、六時でいいですか。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: Checking, not proposing. Small rise at the end.

lines.text: じゃあ、どこで待ち合わせしますか。
lines.speaker: learner
lines.deliveryIntent: Settling a detail. Even, unhurried.

lines.text: 駅の東口はどうですか。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: Easy suggestion, no emphasis.

lines.text: 楽しみにしています。
lines.speaker: learner
lines.deliveryIntent: The closing beat of the learner's arc. Warm, unhurried.

lines.text: では、また土曜日に。
lines.speaker: coworker
lines.deliveryIntent: Closing beat, lighter and shorter than everything before it.
